project_overview.project_name: I want to publish my paperback book. I am looking for an editor who can help me polish my manuscript
project_overview.project_summary: This editorial / publishing project centers on I want to publish my paperback book. I am looking for an editor who can help me polish my manuscript. The initial brief says: I have a manuscript which I would like to publish as a paperback. This book is related to new parents. The work sits mainly in Publishing and editorial content, Writing, Editing & Proofreading Services. Stable project themes include content drafting and editing, style, clarity, and voice consistency, publication-ready document delivery. The available evidence includes 194 conversation messages, 3 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .docx, .pdf, .mp4 formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For onboarding, the key task is to understand the intended audience, source assets, production workflow, review loop, delivery formats, and constraints that determine acceptance. No inspectable software repository was identified, so technical details are limited to what the brief, conversation, and artifacts explicitly establish.
